subject: general
question: Identify the acid that helps in digestion.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hydrochloric acid.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **hydrochloric acid** in the** ****gastric juice** breaks down the food and the digestive enzymes split up the proteins. 
 
• The acidic gastric juice also** kills bacteria.**
 
• It also **eliminates bacteria and viruses** in the stomach,** protecting your body from infection.**
 
• Low levels of hydrochloric acid can have a** profound impact on the body's ability to properly digest and absorb nutrients.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Nitric Acid is **a strong acid with the chemical formula HNO₃**.
 
• It is also known as the** spirit of niter and aqua fortis.​​ **
 
• **Acetic acid** is also known as **ethanoic acid, ethylic acid, vinegar acid, and methane carboxylic acid**; it has the chemical formula of **CH****3****COOH.**
 
• **Sulfuric acid or sulphuric acid, known in antiquity as oil of vitriol**, is a mineral acid composed of the elements sulfur, oxygen, and hydrogen, with the molecular formula **H₂SO₄. **
